free_tier.stated: Free plan: '2GB total storage', up to 50 items, up to 3 canvases. Storage is per TEAM, and team creation is self-service and unlimited: 'CREATE TEAM ... Available to anyone. Available on all plans', and 'A user can be a member of several teams at the same time'.

egress.terms: No egress pricing published; attachments served from app.nuclino.com. Not metered anywhere on the pricing page.

record.tooling: Documented public REST API (help.nuclino.com) with a real rate-limit and error contract. No rclone backend.
record.chaining: 2 GB x unlimited free teams per user. 10 teams = 20 GB; 100 = 200 GB. This is the cleanest multiply-a-workspace in the niche because the docs state outright that a user can hold many teams and that CREATE TEAM is available to anyone on any plan.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: 10 MB per file. The API documents `413 .. an uploaded file exceeds the maximum size of 10 MB (code: FILE_TOO_LARGE)`, and a request body over 100 KB also 413s. request-rate: documented `429` rate limiting (separate page). Retention: no expiry documented; storage is freed only by deletion.
record.reliability_note: Hard 10 MB per-file ceiling makes this shard-only; the 2 GB team quota is small enough that item limits (50 items) bind before bytes do on the Free plan.
